title: Hatsune Miku — Happy Anniversary! 2025〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Seems like everyone's here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Without further ado! Let us commence the Miku's Anniversary Special Excursion meeting!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Miku, Rin & Len
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Isn't this great, Miku? You've been wanting to go on an excursion for so long.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What? You want to go on an excursion for your anniversary, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not do a show?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wanna buy snacks with just my allowance, and spend the whole trip home talking about how much fun we had♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup, yup♪ Buying snacks and getting ready is also part of the fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I get that, but so far... We've only talked about the prep work before, and the way home after.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're right! What happened to the activities?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's alright.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If you'd like to leave it up to us, then we'll think of activities that you'd enjoy, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really?! Then, let's do that♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I've been so excited for the excursion all of you planned☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I guarantee that it'll be interesting and fun.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Before we depart, I'll be checking everyone's stuff☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Does everyone have the itinerary Emu and Nene made?

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Do you have all of your snacks?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah♪ I have the snacks I bought with you. I made sure not to eat them before today, too☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, excellent!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That backpack looks like it'd make a great pillow. What's inside?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I have stuff for our activities in here. Although, we'll only get to use them after we arrive at our location...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh yeah, it says that we have three activities on the itinerary. That means we get to play three times♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But it also says we'll be doing the first activity while we're walking.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe. That's because our first activity is singing while we walk together♪

rows.Speaker: Miku, Rin & Len
rows.Line: Singing?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, now that we're done checking, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! Let's set forth!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nene, let's sing together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Sure.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh! You look like you're having so much fun♪ Can we join too?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Tsukasa! Tsukasa! Can I have my snacks now?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, of course! We have arrived at our destination, after all.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yay☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, let's start the second activity while we're having our snacks.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Our next activity will be... “What's in the box?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As the name suggests, you need to figure out what's in the box only from touch! But don't worry, I've already made sure that it won't include anything strange.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Well, that is if you assume it is an ordinary dog plushie. However...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (They have no idea it's a dog plushie from SEKAI that agreed to be a part of my plan. Hehehe...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Yikes. He's totally planning something...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The last activity will be... “Team Badminton Rallies♪”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Split into Team Miku and Team Tsukasa, and hit the shuttle as many times as you can in three minutes!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Each team only has two rackets. As soon as you hit the shuttle, make sure to pass the racket to another team member.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. It's not enough just to juggle the shuttle, you need to remember to pass the racket as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That sounds like so much fun♪
Let's do our best, Team☆

rows.Speaker: Emu, Rui, Len & MEIKO
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We're back!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehehe☆ Look at that, everyone is all smiles and sunshine!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. I suppose our excursion has finally come to an end.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Tsukasa, Emu, Nene, Rui! Thank you for putting this excursion together!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I had so, so, sooo much fun☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! I'm so glad!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And thank you for coming on this excursion with me, everyone♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You are most welcome. But, it's still a little early to thank us.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's right! Now it's time for your anniversary party!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui, KAITO, let us bring out the tables and chairs!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Let us help too, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: MEIKO, what shall I do?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wow, you haven't been sleepy at all today. In that case, would you help me bring out the food and cake?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Look, Miku! The Miku in our world's show just started!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What?! A show?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Give me a few minutes and I'll get it set up on the big screen.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Amazing...! This is so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I can't believe you also planned all of this on top of the excursion!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! We're here to make sure you enjoy this day to the fullest!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks! I'll be sure to do just that☆
